title: COMMON CAKE
instructions: One cupful of butter, two of sugar, three of flour, four eggs, a little milk,  soda and nutmeg. Beat the sugar and butter together. Beat the eggs separately, and mix with sugar and butter and add the flour.
cookbook_title: Cooking in old Créole days : La cuisine créole à l'usage des petits ménages
